items.title: What Does The S&P 500 Earnings Boom Say About The Stock Market?
items.summary: S&P 500 earnings per share are on pace to climb more than 50% in the second quarter.  Combining reported and yet-to-be-reported results, S&P 500 earnings are up 50.4%, according to the most recent data from FactSet.  Profit growth is broad, too, with 10 of the 11 S&P 500 sectors posting year-over-year earnings growth.
